name: Saudi Arabia
regionName: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

profile.religions: Muslim (official; citizens are 85-90% Sunni and 10-12% Shia), other (includes Eastern Orthodox, Protestant, Roman Catholic, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, and Sikh) (2020 est.)
profile.legalSystem: Islamic (sharia) system with some elements of Egyptian, French, and customary law; commercial disputes handled by special committees
profile.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal for municipal elections
profile.nationalHoliday: Saudi National Day (Unification of the Kingdom), 23 September (1932)
profile.location: Middle East, bordering the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea, north of Yemen
